quest.title: Moonlit Patrol Exercise
quest.description: On the outskirts of Paha Isle, a fierce wargame simulation seems to be unfolding...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4

talks.objective: Take a walk in the outskirts

dialogues.speaker: Wislawa
dialogues.text: Well, well, well, if it isn't the kind-hearted merchant... Out here chasing business, are we?

dialogues.speaker: Edler
dialogues.text: *sigh* You wouldn't understand. Us poor folk with nothing to our names have to go where the money is — like hungry dogs chasing after scraps of bone...

dialogues.speaker: Wislawa
dialogues.text: You might want to pay more attention to what's going on in front of you — I reckon you're about to lose.

dialogues.speaker: Edler
dialogues.text: #I wouldn't be so sure... Ah, {NICKNAME}, just in time. Perhaps you can help me figure out how to reverse my fortunes?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, you're asking the right person!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This looks different from when I last played...

dialogues.speaker: Edler
dialogues.text: Ha, indeed! If I'm going to set up shop in a new locale, I need to spice things up a little — you're looking at my new and improved wargame!

dialogues.speaker: Edler
dialogues.text: Basically, there's a wider variety of gameplay. There's "Frontline Captains," and different kinds of flags... It feels a lot more like commanding a real army!

dialogues.speaker: Edler
dialogues.text: However, just as I was trying to sell it to prospective buyers, this fine lady turned up and threw a spanner in the works.

dialogues.speaker: Edler
dialogues.text: To prove my product is all above board — and to prevent concerned onlookers from reporting me to the authorities — I had no choice but to play a round with her. Otherwise, she might accuse me of selling "dangerous military equipment"!

dialogues.speaker: Wislawa
dialogues.text: #Thank you for sharing your — remarkably long — side of the story... Hello, you must be the famous {NICKNAME}? And that would make your companion the world-renowned, expert guide, Paimon. I've been hearing a lot about you two!

dialogues.speaker: Wislawa
dialogues.text: I never expected our kind-hearted Fontainian merchant here to keep such exalted company... I feel honored to see you in the flesh.

dialogues.speaker: Wislawa
dialogues.text: It's just a pity we haven't played out our game, otherwise I'd be able to take good care of you...

choices.text: (Does she mean take care, or "take care"?)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You seem nice! Usually, when we bump into people with your sense of style... uhm, how should Paimon put it... they don't do much talking before their fists start flying!

response.speaker: Wislawa
response.text: Haha, don't worry, I'm on holiday! Besides, even when I'm working, I try my best not to get too physical. Either way you look at it, you've nothing to fear from me.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But you two look like you might come to blows...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon was thinking that too! Even though you're playing wargames, when we turned up, the atmosphere was a little... uhm, tense, but maybe it was just a mix-up...

response.speaker: Wislawa
response.text: You think we should spar? That's a great idea!

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: I suppose we could slug it out...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, hey, hey! Paimon was just thinking out loud — it wasn't a suggestion!

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: Haha, don't worry, we're just pulling your leg.

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: Though it really does seem like this new product has the ability to help resolve disputes. When two people are at loggerheads and feel the itch to start fighting, they can whip out my wargame and—

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: Ugh, yap-yap-yap. How about you just try it for yourselves?

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: Or... you could help me beat our enthusiastic bodyguard here first.

choices.text: (She looks like she'd make a dangerous enemy...)
